title: Metroid Fusion
sources: own RAM search with gbaverify on this ROM (Japanese base + English patch): energy u16 found at 0x03001344 (99 at the start); the equipment block is the US layout (RA game 785, as used for the US def) moved by +0x34
RetroAchievements game 1000010111 (this hash) lists the same 0x03001344 block, without descriptions

widgets.text:
Energy tanks, missiles, power bombs shown on the HUD
X parasites refill energy/ammo when absorbed

Charge Beam, Wide, Plasma, Wave, Ice Missiles, Diffusion Missiles
Varia, Gravity suit; Space Jump; Screw Attack; Speed Booster
Abilities come from downloads and from absorbed Core-X bosses

Arachnus (Morph Ball bombs), Zazabi (shoot its mouth when it opens)
Serris (Speed Booster), Yakuza (Space Jump), Nightmare (Gravity)
Ridley-X, Nettori (Plasma), Mega-X; final: Omega Metroid

rows: run, don't fight until the end

widgets.text:
Main Deck + 6 Sectors: SRX (1), TRO (2), PYR (3), AQA (4), ARC (5), NOC (6)
Navigation rooms give objectives; Save rooms; Data rooms

Missiles (Super, Ice, Diffusion), Power Bombs
Energy Tanks (up to 20), Missile Tanks (48), Power Bomb Tanks (32)

100% = 20 E-tanks + 48 missile + 32 power bomb tanks
Item percentage shown on the clear screen

Story events per sector; downloads from Navigation rooms
Ending picture depends on time and item %
English translation in the Translations folder; version 1.0 (from the file name)

notes: verified: energy 99/99 at the first room, play time h/m/s at 0x0300013C counting. missiles/PB/beam/suit bit meanings carried over from the US layout, not seen changing yet
